preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some amount of the honeyToken to initiate transfer
Contract must have non-zero CHARITY_FEE set (default is set in constructor)

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is in the _reflectFee function where charity fee is subtracted from _rTotal but not from _tTotal (unlike burn fee). This creates an inconsistency between reflection and token totals. Exploit by: 1. Ensure you have some tokens, 2. Transfer tokens to trigger fee calculation, 3. The charity fee amount will be subtracted from _rTotal but not _tTotal, causing the rate (rTotal/tTotal) to decrease disproportionately, 4. This allows attackers to receive more tokens than they should when converting reflections to tokens. Perform multiple transfers to amplify the effect.
